text:
Hey mixed couples,
I am moving away from Israel after 5 years of the partnership visa process. My visa got extended during the war till past the date that I am leaving Israel this summer. I am supposed to have another visa renewal meeting before this moment next month. Can I skip this meeting without heavy consequences you think? Not planning to move back to Israel in the future, and even if so, I start over again with the process I believe. Would love to hear what you think.
